reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Aquarium Visit Rules 033
materials.text: At the aquarium, look through the glass without tapping it. Keep the walkway clear. The feeding talk starts when the guide arrives. Phones may take pictures without flash. Wet coats stay in the entrance rack. Ask the helper before leaving the group.

questions.prompt: A friend taps the glass to make a fish move. You say, "____"
options: Please ask about the feeding time.
Please put your coat on the rack.
questions.explanation: A直接纠敲玻璃；B问时间、C放外套虽可做但不解决当前敲击。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves a bag in the walkway. You say, "____"
options: Move your bag so the path is clear.
questions.explanation: B挪包解决阻道；A先看鱼、C问时间不清通道。

questions.prompt: The guide has not arrived, and a friend asks if the feeding talk starts now. You say, "____"
options: The coats stay at the entrance.
We wait until the guide arrives.
questions.explanation: C讲解等导游；A外套、B拍照是别规则不答开讲时机。

questions.prompt: A friend switches on the phone flash. You say, "____"
options: Keep your wet coat at the entrance.
questions.explanation: A直接纠开闪光；B外套、C鱼大小不能处理当前拍摄方式。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to leave the group for another room. You say, "____"
options: Put your bag on the rack.
Wait for the feeding fish to swim.
questions.explanation: B离组前问帮手；A收包、C等鱼不满足人员告知条件。

materials.title: Supermarket Family Needs 033
materials.text: A child shops with family. Choose the sentence that asks for exactly the information or help needed.

questions.prompt: You need bread and do not know which aisle has it. What do you ask?
options: Where can I return a basket?
questions.explanation: A找面包所在通道；B果汁价、C还篮点都是购物问题但不找面包。

questions.prompt: A jar is too high for you to reach. You ask an adult for that jar. What do you say?
options: Could you get that jar down for me?
Could you show me the milk?
questions.explanation: B明确请成人取高罐；A价核、C牛奶位置不解决够不到目标。

questions.prompt: Your list says plain yogurt, but the pot is labelled strawberry. What do you ask?
options: Is there a plain one without strawberry?
questions.explanation: C据草莓标与原味需求询替代；A篮、B结账点无关口味辨认。

questions.prompt: You think the basket belongs to another family. You want to check before taking it. What do you ask?
options: Does this milk need a fridge?
questions.explanation: A确认篮物主；B面包新鲜、C牛奶保存虽合理但不核篮归属。

questions.prompt: The checkout helper asks if you need a bag. Your family brought one. What do you say?
options: We have our own bag, thank you.
questions.explanation: B自带袋明确回应需要否；A收据、C柜台位置不回答提问。

units.title: 社区开放日的十段完整语境

materials.title: Community Day Ten Choices 033
materials.text: Read each full community-day situation and choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: The two helpers ____ carrying a long sign together.
questions.explanation: A two helpers复数配are；B单三is、C I配am不合。

questions.prompt: The sign is for our group. Please give it to ____.
questions.explanation: B to后宾格us；A主格we、C物主our需后接名词。

questions.prompt: The floor is wet. We walk slowly so we do not ____.
questions.explanation: C湿地慢行避免滑倒slip；A唱、B借不是湿地风险所对应动作。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the door for the person carrying the box.
questions.explanation: A祈使原形hold，帮助双手搬箱者；B单三、C分词不构成所需指令。

questions.prompt: Does the hall have a lift? Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: B Does问用does答且it单数；A do不配it；C are不答have助动词句。

questions.prompt: The bag belongs to my uncle. It is ____ bag.
questions.explanation: C uncle男性his；A她的、B我们的不符已给物主。

questions.prompt: The quiet room is for reading. Please keep voices ____.
questions.explanation: A low低声符合阅读安静；B圆、C渴不描述音量。

questions.prompt: There are two clean ____ beside the water jug.
questions.explanation: B two要求cups标准复数；A单数；C拼写错误。

questions.prompt: ____ room is the art workshop in? Room Five.
questions.explanation: C Which room对应五室；A时间、B人员不修饰房间辨认。

questions.prompt: We ____ not leave our bags in the exit. The sign asks us to keep it clear.
questions.explanation: A must not加leave表示禁堵；B/C be后直接not leave不成此句谓语。

units.title: 纸艺活动里的五个问答

materials.title: Paper Craft Checking Replies 033
materials.text:
Match each question with its best reply. Use each bank reply once.
A. Because the glue must dry before folding.
B. The helper at the labelled tool table.
C. After we have checked the whole list.
D. Yes, if you use your own name card.
E. In the tray for unfinished pieces.

questions.prompt: Why are we waiting before closing the paper roof?
options: Because the glue must dry before folding.
The helper at the labelled tool table.
After we have checked the whole list.
Yes, if you use your own name card.
In the tray for unfinished pieces.
questions.explanation: A胶干后才折合解释等待；B人、C核整表后时机、D本人名牌条件、E未完盘不答胶合原因。

questions.prompt: Who can give us the shared scissors?
options: Because the glue must dry before folding.
The helper at the labelled tool table.
After we have checked the whole list.
Yes, if you use your own name card.
In the tray for unfinished pieces.
questions.explanation: B工具桌帮手答人员；A胶因、C时机、D名牌、E未完盘不提供发工具者。

questions.prompt: When may we tell the teacher that every item is ready?
options: Because the glue must dry before folding.
The helper at the labelled tool table.
After we have checked the whole list.
Yes, if you use your own name card.
In the tray for unfinished pieces.
questions.explanation: C核完整清单后才能报齐；A胶干原因不涵盖所有物件，B人、D名牌、E存处均不答核齐条件。

questions.prompt: May I take a turn at the model table?
options: Because the glue must dry before folding.
The helper at the labelled tool table.
After we have checked the whole list.
Yes, if you use your own name card.
In the tray for unfinished pieces.
questions.explanation: D可但用本人名牌，答轮次许可；A原因、B人、C齐表时机、E未完盘不答此排轮条件。

questions.prompt: Where should a half-made wall section go?
options: Because the glue must dry before folding.
The helper at the labelled tool table.
After we have checked the whole list.
Yes, if you use your own name card.
In the tray for unfinished pieces.
questions.explanation: E未完零件盘对应half-made；A原因、B人员、C时间、D许可不答存储。

units.title: 社区艺术路线的五个词

materials.title: Community Art Path Bank 033
materials.text:
Choose from the bank to complete the full passage. Use each word once. Bank: A. around B. clean C. before D. borrow E. slowly
We walk ____1____ the pond on the marked path, making a full circle. Visitors may ____2____ a clipboard from the desk for drawing. We keep the clips ____3____ so they do not mark the paper. The guide asks us to move ____4____ near the small steps. We return the boards ____5____ leaving the garden, not after we go home.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A around池塘绕一圈与full circle相应；B clean状态、C before时间、D borrow动作、E slowly方式不表围绕路线。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D may borrow借画板；A around、C before介词，B clean此处无法表达从台借取，E slowly副词不作所需借用动词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B keep clips clean保持夹洁净不染纸；A around、C before、D borrow、E slowly不能作该洁净状态表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: E slowly修饰move近小阶慢走；A around缺所需宾语、B clean状态、C before时间、D borrow动作不表速度方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C before leaving园内离前归还，与not after home对比；A around不表该时序，B clean、D borrow、E slowly不连接离开时机。

units.title: 开放工作室的五项确认

materials.title: Open Studio Day Replies 033
materials.text:
Match each question with the reply that directly fits it. Use each reply once.
A. The room shown on the updated programme.
B. Because the surface is still damp.
C. The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
D. After the last visitor has collected their work.
E. Yes, if you keep the walkway open.

questions.prompt: Which room should we use after the timetable change?
options: The room shown on the updated programme.
Because the surface is still damp.
The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
After the last visitor has collected their work.
Yes, if you keep the walkway open.
questions.explanation: A更新节目单房间答改期后房室；B湿面原因、C钥匙人、D结束时机、E通道条件不辨室。

questions.prompt: Why must we wait before placing books on the painted shelf?
options: The room shown on the updated programme.
Because the surface is still damp.
The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
After the last visitor has collected their work.
Yes, if you keep the walkway open.
questions.explanation: B表面仍潮解释不能压书；A房、C人、D末访时机、E通道许可不答漆面原因。

questions.prompt: Who should receive the spare key?
options: The room shown on the updated programme.
Because the surface is still damp.
The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
After the last visitor has collected their work.
Yes, if you keep the walkway open.
questions.explanation: C负责共钥教师答人员；A房室、B原因、D时间、E许可不答接收者。

questions.prompt: When should we pack away the collection table?
options: The room shown on the updated programme.
Because the surface is still damp.
The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
After the last visitor has collected their work.
Yes, if you keep the walkway open.
questions.explanation: D最后访者领作后答收台时机；A房、B湿、C钥匙人、E通道不答When。

questions.prompt: May we put our drawing boards along this wall?
options: The room shown on the updated programme.
Because the surface is still damp.
The teacher responsible for the shared keys.
After the last visitor has collected their work.
Yes, if you keep the walkway open.
questions.explanation: E可以但保持走道开，答靠墙放板条件；A改房、B湿架原因、C人、D收台时机不答此许可。

materials.title: Quiet Museum Bench Six Cloze 033
materials.text:
Read the full story and choose a word for every gap.
Our class visited a small museum. I wanted to see every room ____1____, but my friend Eva stopped at a bench. I thought she was bored. She explained that the bright display lights made her eyes ____2____. The bench was in a softer light. I sat beside her and read the short guide ____3____ she rested. A helper showed us another route with fewer bright rooms. We did not need to leave the museum ____4____. We could choose the parts that worked for us that day. I asked Eva before planning the ____5____ stop, instead of guessing what she wanted. We both enjoyed the visit more ____6____ we talked about the real difficulty.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A wanted quickly看全馆快节奏；B木制、C渴不是参观速度方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B强光使眼不适解释软光休息；A方、C空不描述本段实际感受。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C while她休息时我读导览，同时动作；A除非条件、B空间不连接此同时从句。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A不必完全离馆，有替代路线；B形容安静、C圆不表达全部离开程度。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B next stop下一站先问；A睡着、C重不是行程次序。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C谈真实困难促双方更享受，为因果；A选择、B之前不解释改进原因。

units.title: 合买礼物时的共同收据

materials.title: Paper Receipt Shared Gift 033
materials.text: Four classmates bought a plant for their teacher. Each agreed to give ten yuan. At the shop, the pot they had chosen was unavailable, so they bought a smaller one costing thirty-two yuan. The pupil who paid first kept the receipt. She did not simply collect the planned ten yuan from everyone. She showed the actual cost and divided it equally. Each paid eight yuan. They kept the remaining money rather than buying an extra item without discussing it. The group wrote the plant’s care note on a card, and the receipt stayed in their shared project folder.

questions.prompt: The original plan was ten yuan from each of four pupils.
questions.explanation: A正确：four每人ten；B否认初始约定。

questions.prompt: The plant they actually bought cost forty yuan.
questions.explanation: B正确：实际32，40只是计划总额；A把预算当实支。

questions.prompt: The payer showed the receipt before dividing the actual cost.
questions.explanation: A正确：showed actual cost then equally；B否认透明核算。

questions.prompt: Each pupil finally paid eight yuan.
questions.explanation: A正确：32四分为8，原文也明说；B否认实际分摊。

questions.prompt: The group spent the leftover money on an extra item without discussion.
questions.explanation: B正确：kept remaining，不擅买；A反向叙述。

materials.title: Festival Note Word Forms 033
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Yesterday, our group ____1____ (leave) the hall after returning every tool.
2. The display included three model ____2____ (wolf), each with a different pose.
3. The second route was ____3____ (short) than the long walk around the lake.
4. Look! The children are ____4____ (tie) name tags onto their bags.
5. The guide explained the change ____5____ (calm) when several visitors were confused.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use LEAVE.
questions.explanation: 接受left：Yesterday过去，leave不规则；leave原形、leaved错误、leaving分词不作过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use WOLF.
questions.explanation: 接受wolves：three明确复数，wolf变wolves；wolf单数、wolfs本题动物复数错误、wolveses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use SHORT.
questions.explanation: 接受shorter：than比较路线长度；short原级、shortest最高级、shortness名词不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use TIE.
questions.explanation: 明确接受tying：are加现在分词，tie变tying。tie原形不成此处进行时，tied过去式不合正在系牌。tieing的异体拼写未穷尽核实，不预列为错，按未列形式复核。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use CALM.
questions.explanation: 明确接受calmly修饰explained表示镇静说明；calmer无比较条件，calmness名词不作方式副词，未列形式按review。

units.title: 作业支持时问到需要的信息

materials.title: Homework Support Functions 033
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly answers the learner’s stated purpose. All options are possible school requests, but only one fits each need.

questions.prompt: You understand the answer but not the reason. You want the reasoning explained. What should you say?
options: Could you explain why that answer works?
Could you tell me tomorrow’s classroom?
Could you lend me a ruler?
questions.explanation: A问推理原因；B明日室号、C借尺是学校需求但不解理由。

questions.prompt: You cannot read the teacher’s written comment and need it read aloud. What should you ask?
options: Could you read this comment aloud to me?
Could we move the next lesson?
questions.explanation: B把难辨评论朗读解决读取；A新练习、C改课不读取现评。

questions.prompt: You want to check whether group discussion is allowed for this assignment. What should you ask?
options: Where should the finished work be placed?
May we discuss the ideas together before writing our own answers?
questions.explanation: C确认讨论与独立成答的合作边界；A开放时、B交件地点不答允许协作否。

questions.prompt: You know the deadline but need the submission place. What should you ask?
options: Where should I submit the completed work?
questions.explanation: A问交件处，截止时已知不需B；C题数不解决提交位置。

questions.prompt: You missed one instruction and want the specific step repeated. What should you say?
options: Could I borrow your coloured pencils?
Could you repeat the step after we label the diagram?
questions.explanation: B定位标图之后那步请求重说；A借笔、C出勤核对不补漏步骤。
